editorial.jobs_exams: No routine recruitment, job or exam notices included
editorial.script_originality: Original Hindi narration; not copied or translated from source articles
editorial.sensationalism: No rumour, communal/caste bait, misleading claim or graphic detail
editorial.story_mix: Western UP road safety and farmer procurement occupy 35%; national stories focus on food inflation, disaster recovery, fuel/food trade-off, consumer labelling, cyber safety, minerals and localised cracker restrictions.

research_verification.note: PTI/ThePrint and multiple local reports confirm two deaths and police case. Vehicle count and injured count differ; script omits exact disputed count and excludes alleged intoxication/BSF identity.
Amrit Vichar and Live Hindustan corroborate protest and demands. ₹600/quintal is clearly a demand, not an announced rate; no administration decision claimed.
CPI figures from PIB/MoSPI; soil moisture and price risk attributed to Reuters and described as forward-looking.
Three reports corroborate cyclone recovery; all damage estimates are labelled preliminary.
15–17% blending is an industry estimate, not a final government target.
Regulator's court argument and company dispute are both attributed; no final hearing outcome or toxicity claim.
I4C warning is correctly framed as directed to financial institutions; practical customer advice is separated.
Cabinet parameters supported by official PIB/PM India and Reuters.
Restrictions are explicitly limited to Delhi-NCR and stated dates/times; local district orders should also be checked.
IMD warning map checked at 04:20 IST. West UP no-warning statement is subdivision-level; stale city temperatures are not presented as current.

script_originality_review.details: 1218-word original Hindi narration written from source facts with distinct structure and explanatory context.

sensitive_content_review.details: Road accident handled without gore, victim imagery or unverified personal detail; no communal/caste angle.

rights_review.narration: Kokoro-82M hm_omega, Apache-2.0; local synthesis only

visual_audio_clearance.details: All still photographs have source page, creator, rights holder, licence version, commercial/adaptation permission and attribution. Every scene includes matching asset ID and licence URL. On-screen illustrative label is enabled for every scene. Human review of framing and attribution remains required.

technical_checks.details: Workflow must verify 1920x1080, 540–660 seconds, audio stream, SRT and uploaded provenance artifact. Do not claim technical success until run and artifact are checked.

required_human_review: Listen to the full Kokoro hm_omega Hindi narration for pronunciation, natural pacing, intelligibility, clipping and abrupt cuts.
Check that the on-screen 'प्रतीकात्मक तस्वीर' label is visible and legible in every scene; all stills are generic and not actual event footage.
Review the Amroha road-safety segment for sensitivity; no real accident imagery is used.
Review the lithium facility scene label that explicitly says Nevada, not an Indian plant.
Confirm the Delhi-NCR cracker restrictions remain current and the district scope is clear.
Confirm the supplied SRT is attached during any later YouTube upload; subtitles are a sidecar, not burned into the MP4.
final_gate: HOLD — draft render is allowed for review, but do not publish or schedule until human listening, visual-label review and final editorial approval are complete.
